connections.how: Edge-delivered pages send consented website events through Adobe Experience Platform Web SDK. Customer Journey Analytics reads the event dataset through a configured CJA connection and data view.

source.title: Experience League: Ingest data via the Adobe Experience Platform Web SDK

flows.what: Consented page and interaction events from Edge Delivery pages, via Web SDK, an Experience Platform datastream and an event dataset.

source.title: Experience League: Ingest data via the Adobe Experience Platform Web SDK

lines.name: Measure Edge Delivery page and block interactions
lines.scope: Instrument the agreed page and block events on Edge Delivery that the existing collection does not capture. Use the existing consent controls, Web SDK, datastream, dataset and CJA connection. Verify consent handling and trace sample events to the CJA data view. Assign consent platform integration and any shared collection setup once under the site or analytics work.
lines.evidence: This quick start guide explains how you can ingest website tracking data directly into Adobe Experience Platform using the Adobe Experience Platform Web SDK and Edge Network and then use that data in Customer Journey Analytics.
